definition:
flowchart LR
  A["日本語のラベル 中文標籤 한국어"] --> B["🚀 emoji ✅ mixed ⚠️ 🔥"]
  B --> C["مرحبا بالعالم RTL שלום"]
  C --> D["Ελληνικά Цириллица ẞ"]
  D --> E["combining é́ ẘ̈ ZWJ 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦"]
  E --> A
intent: Unicode/CJK/RTL/emoji/ZWJ/combining-mark labels in one flowchart. Probes font fallback, glyph clipping, node width measurement for wide (CJK) and bidi (Arabic/Hebrew) runs, and whether ZWJ family emoji renders as one glyph or four. Text is drawn on the node fill, so it is also a text-on-colored-element contrast case in both themes.
